name: Hypertime Oracle
_notes: Transcribed from sheet CU1384 + cards CR1343-CR1365, CS1366-CS1383 (Cycle III).
Bonus row: ✵ = ESCALATION, ◎ = AT, Λ/Ψ = Danger/Fate bonus (DF): adds to FATE dealt by an attack, or DANGER if the attack deals no FATE. Lv V+ per hit.
Lv III/IV right box (+3 / +12 jar icon) is a campaign reward value — ignored.
Quantum Eye BPs (user): Inner Eye Colony, Invisible Eyes Parasite, Living Lenses, Many-Eyed Face, Ontological Antennae, Ripen Realities, Temporal Sash, Voidheart, Wing Eye Colony

traits.Timefront Beckons: End of Titan Round: ⚡ Move the Timefront 3 spaces forward (towards the right Board Edge). If the Timefront moves onto a space occupied by a Titan, this Titan is erased from existence. If the Timefront moves onto a space with a Terrain tile, this tile is destroyed (unless Indestructible). When the Timefront is about to move onto a space occupied by the Primordial, move the Primordial directly away from the Timefront to enable full Timefront movement if possible.
traits.Death by Fate: When a Primordial Attack deals FATE, it triggers a Trauma Draw (like DANGER). If an Attack deals both, resolve only one Trauma Draw. Being dealt FATE over 9 causes an Obol Draw instead of a Moiros Draw. Trauma severity uses the higher of DANGER or FATE.
traits.Extinguish Possibilities: Start of Primordial Round: Look at the top Trauma card from each deck. If it's positive, remove it from the Battle. If it's negative, leave it on top.
traits.Voracious Parasite: The Hypertime Oracle consumes all Time Anchors it moves through and all Time Anchors it is adjacent to at the end of the Primordial Round. Remove consumed Time Anchors from the Battle Board.
traits.Once Upon A Time: Each time the Oracle consumes a Time Anchor or gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, when there are 4 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens, then draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Quantum Eye: If you reveal a BP card with the open-eyed symbol as a result of a card or an ability effect (not during a normal BP Draw), gain FATE equal to the BP card's level.
traits.Hypertimefront: Level 3: When the Timefront moves, it moves 4 spaces forward instead. Level 4+: When the Timefront moves, it moves 5 spaces forward instead.
traits.Omega Terminus: Additional Setup: Place the Omega Terminus Status card near the Primordial Sheet. Instead of the normal effect, a Titan that suffers Crash is immediately moved onto that card. (Status card: While on this card, during your turn, you can only unexhaust and/or attack. If you deal a Wound, place your Titan on a space adjacent to the Timefront in a straight line from the Oracle. If you fail to Wound, ignore Responses. At the end of your turn, if you are still in the Omega Terminus, you are erased from existence. Zeus Godform gains +1 Power here.)
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Layover: Start of Titan Round: The Titan with the most FATE is moved to the Omega Terminus.
traits.Gaze of the Void: Start of Primordial Round (except 1st): All Titans in front of the Oracle die.
traits.Quantumfront: When the Timefront moves, it moves 6 spaces instead.
traits.Temporal Ruthlessness: If you draw a positive Trauma card or an Obol, ignore it and draw again (once per Draw).
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.

ai.name: In Medias Res
ai.text: Starting from the lowest FATE and continuing in ascending order, Titans must draw and resolve a Minor, Major and Grave Trauma (one card per Titan). Then remove this card from the Battle and draw another AI card. This card never escalates.

ai.name: Darkest Timeline
ai.text: The Oracle moves 4 spaces towards the Timefront (stop if adjacent). Rewind all Titans. For the duration of this Battle the Hypertime Oracle becomes one level higher (it gains new Traits and stats). Then, remove this card from the Battle and shuffle the Aeons Tsunami AI card into the AI deck. Draw another AI card.

steps:
⚡ MOVE LATERAL & ATTACK
| PARADOX 3+ or FATE 8+: Double Laser instead
ai.after: Repeat Overtime Laser against a Titan that has not been Attacked this round by Overtime Laser. Repeat until all Titans have been Attacked, then the Oracle moves 5 spaces towards the Timefront (stop if adjacent) and turns to face the most Titans.

ai.name: Sun's Harbinger
steps:

| PARADOX 5+ or FATE 9+: You are erased from existence
If the Attack hits, it deals 9 DANGER. Death 1.
ai.after: ⚡ The Oracle moves 5 spaces towards the Timefront (stop if adjacent) and turns to face the most Titans. Glaciate the previous Primordial space.

ai.name: Tyranny of Stars
target: All Titans on the Battle Board
steps: ⚡ TELEPORT ALL TITANS & JUDGE: Reestablish the Time Anchors of teleported Titans.
⚡ Perform Signature against each adjacent Titan, ignoring its After Attack effect.
ai.afterFinal:

The Oracle moves 5 spaces towards the Timefront (stop if adjacent) and turns to face the most Titans.

steps: Each hit deals 3 FATE. If hit, gain DANGER equal to your FATE.
